title: The Online Boolean Matrix-Vector Multiplication Conjecture
exact_target: Can one multiply a Boolean matrix by an online sequence of vectors in genuinely subcubic total time, while answering each vector before seeing the next?

sources.citation: Kasper Green Larsen and Ryan Williams, Faster Online Matrix-Vector Multiplication, arXiv:1605.01695v2 (2016), Conjecture 1.1.
